newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ govt sets news conference on Works Corp sale.
newsitem.headline: NZ govt sets news conference on Works Corp sale.

text.p: New Zealand State-Owned Enterprises Minister Philip Burdon said on Tuesday he would hold a news conference at 3.30 p.m. (0330 GMT) on the status of negotiations regarding the divestment of Works Corp.
The government started the sales process for the engineering consultancy in February.
The Dominion newspaper reported on Tuesday that the government was poised to sell Works and it quoted sources saying a company linked to merchant bank Fay, Richwhite may be the buyer.

Works had revenues of $280 million in the year to June 1995 and a profit of $12.2 million. Radio New Zealand reported Works Corp's book value was $75 million and a sale of around $80 million would be considered reasonable.
